# Golden fixtures

Generated by running the real `elixir-protobuf/protobuf` escript (built at
the HEAD commit pinned in `../../TODO.md`) against `../proto/`. These are
committed so the Go implementation can be diff-tested byte-for-byte without
requiring Elixir/protoc at test time.

Each subdirectory corresponds to one flag scenario (see `../gen_goldens.sh`
for the exact `protoc`/`--elixir_opt` invocation that produced it):

| Directory | Scenario |
|---|---|
| `extension/` | `extension.proto`, `include_docs=true` |
| `package_prefix/` | `test.proto` + `service.proto`, `package_prefix=my,include_docs=true` (no `plugins=grpc`, so no service module) |
| `gen_descriptors/` | `custom_options.proto`, `gen_descriptors=true,include_docs=true` |
| `no_package/` | `no_package.proto`, `include_docs=true` |
| `full_name/` | `full_name.proto`, `gen_proto_source=true,include_docs=true` |
| `grpc/` | `test.proto` + `service.proto`, `plugins=grpc,include_docs=true` |
| `grpc_proto_source/` | `test.proto` + `service.proto`, `plugins=grpc,gen_proto_source=true` (default `include_docs=false`) |
| `transform_module/` | `test.proto`, `transform_module=My.App.Transform` |
| `one_file_per_module/` | `test.proto` + `service.proto`, `one_file_per_module=true,include_docs=true` |
| `path_doubling/` | `foo/bar/mirror.proto` (synthetic), default flags — pins the output-path doubling bug |

## Regenerating

```bash
PROTOC_GEN_ELIXIR_ESCRIPT=/path/to/protobuf-elixir/protoc-gen-elixir \
  bash cmd/protoc-gen-elixir/testdata/gen_goldens.sh
```

Only re-run this if upstream's generation logic changes (i.e. the pinned
commit in `../../TODO.md` moves) or a new scenario is added — never hand-edit
these files.
